description.en: Hold to ignite a paper-burn transition with fluid fire and drifting ash. Restore to pull the burn back into the button.
description.zh: 长按点燃纸张，流体火焰和灰烬向外烧开画面。恢复时，燃烧边缘反向收回按钮。

keywords: 长按 燃烧 烧纸 纸张 焦边 火焰 烟雾 灰烬 恢复 转场 hold burn transition fire fluid smoke ash restore account WebGL2 kshvbgde

useCases: 长按触发纸张燃烧转场并反向恢复
Reveal a second screen through fluid fire and a torn paper edge
discovery.caveat: 账号删除、恢复及登录都是本地演示，不发送网络请求。无浮点WebGL2时仅保留裁切降级效果；原HTML许可未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/WebGL2 core with six native framework entries. All account actions remain local demonstration states.

instructions.en: Hold the button for 2.2 seconds to burn through the screen. Release early to cancel. Use Restore to reverse the transition. Account actions are a local demo.
instructions.zh: 持续长按按钮 2.2 秒烧开画面，提前松手取消。点击 Restore 反向恢复，账号操作仅为本地演示。
